formula.ascii: Level 0 cell (i,j) is the maximum over the valid finite pixels of its S x S block (S = firstBlockSize = 4; footprint 'cell' adds no extra pixel). Level l+1 takes the maximum of the children (2i+a, 2j+b) of level l that exist, compared with strict > from the empty sentinel -FLT_MAX, in the order (0,0), (1,0), (0,1), (1,1); children past an odd edge are skipped, so an edge cell reduces fewer than four. The minimum is the same tree with < from +FLT_MAX; a cell with no valid pixel keeps the sentinel.
